post_barrier_evaluation_amendment.failure: The locked evaluator assumed a source static test prediction for every dynamic head seed. Only source static seeds 42/43/44 existed, so evaluation stopped at seed 45 after its dynamic prediction parquet was written and before results.json/report.md were created.
post_barrier_evaluation_amendment.statement: The original barrier was retained. The evaluator-only amendment restricts the secondary static comparison to real source artifacts; primary model forwards, thresholds, and matched comparisons are unchanged.

secondary_static_seed_scope.policy: intersection_only; missing static seeds are neither copied nor synthesized

limitations: The frozen adapter was trained jointly with an E03 final-layer head.
Head seeds are not independent LoRA seeds.
The source test split has already been explored; this is a post-hoc diagnostic.
The selected-layer arm reuses a validation-driven exploratory layer selection.
The primary threshold is fixed at 0.5; no out-of-fold calibration is fitted in this diagnostic.
Per-source and gate-weight analyses are descriptive and unadjusted for multiplicity.
